features.note: Neutral/grazing/facade preserve the 60x45 grammar: front public band, 7 m spine gap, 4+4 auditorium plates at stepped heights, separated rear service strip (es-arch labels REAR SERVICE + 1-L..8-S). The new public-band unit row reads as an ordered service lane parallel to the facade, evenly spaced and consistently oriented — not clutter; the blockout-vs-final strip confirms zero massing drift, roof furniture only.

2L/4M/2S plates remain independently readable by footprint and height in neutral/es/strip views; sala3-arch shows tiered burgundy seats, abstract screen, aisle LEDs and surround speakers; rooffoff reveals the eight rooms with no phantom ceilings, though their interiors sit near-black at that exposure.

Forecourt walk-line -> glass door bank under red marquee -> lobby counters/kiosks -> concession bar with menus and POS -> kitchen workline with hood strip -> checkpoint at corridor mouth reads continuously; the checkpoint itself is the thinnest link — two bare gray podium boxes with wayfinding arrows but no counter cap, device, or staff cue at its own preset.

Complete-network views show 14 labeled TC300s, four UC cabinets, elevated two-antenna UG67 with pulse rings, and the ROUTER/FIREWALL->INTERNET->NIAGARA->PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE chain with no shortcut edge; faults are canonical (TC300-08: 1 evento; UC100-B: 4 eventos; internet: 14 eventos with the failed segment red and downstream desaturated; hot zones keep 'Niagara sigue recibiendo datos'); t0/t30 pairs show real packet motion (63k/24k px deltas).

Architecture opaque massing and engineering translucent/section states frame the same coherent building across neutral/es/net and all five fault/hot captures; hot-kitchen vs hot-sala3 tint different zones (124k px delta), and layer toggles (roof off, section) never drop endpoint groups.

important_features.note: 1.8 m person proxies at the forecourt and corridor, 2.1 m doors, ~2.5 m RTUs against the 60 m shell, and wall thermostats with labels all sit in one coherent scale; small devices are found via labels/rings, not inflation.

Bright emissive lobby/concession panels step down through warm corridor strips to near-dark salas with blue step LEDs and green exits; all four lightsoff pairs materially change the frame (marquee unlit, exits still legible).

14 curb-seated packaged units align in the public service lane and two plate columns at x±16 with one unit per zone label; strapped joints (white/yellow bands), rust flanged elbows, 8 branch runs to plenum edges, per-unit thin dark condensate runs along the plates, and the kitchen sleeve all read attached — nothing floats in architecture-with-roof views.

headroom_recommendation: The build is at the ceiling of its flat-shaded conceptual style; remaining upside (~0.03-0.05) is purely material and micro-fit-out — land the galvanized read on the duct network, dress the checkpoint podiums, and add a touch of fill light to roof-off interiors. No structural or topological work remains; further attempts past one polish round would be spend without score movement.
defects: Duct mains and all 8 branches render as uniform near-black charcoal boxes in roofservice-arch/technical-arch; the spec's 'galvanized' light-metal read is absent (only the straps and rust elbows separate from the mass).
At checkpoint-arch the two podiums are bare untextured gray boxes: no counter cap, POS/scanner block, or staff proxy at the one preset dedicated to this zone.
In neutral-arch-rooffoff the spine duct assembly stays visible hovering over the open trench with no visible support once its host plates are hidden.
Auditorium interiors in the roof-off probative shot are near-black; tiered seating barely reads at that exposure even though geometry is present.
In facade-arch the two westmost public-band units sit close in-line and momentarily read as one double-length unit at the glancing angle.
corrections: Shift duct branch/main albedo to a light galvanized gray (or add metallic response) so the branch network separates from shadow and matches its declared read.
Dress the checkpoint: add a counter cap, a small scanner/POS block, and one staff person proxy inside the accessible lane.
Parent the spine duct group's visibility to the roof toggle in architecture mode, or add short support stubs so it never hovers unsupported.
Add a small fill/ambient lift to the roof-off state so seating tiers read in the probative capture.
Nudge the two westmost public-band units apart (or stagger their drains) so each silhouette stays discrete from the facade preset.
